title: Cosmic Sorceress and Dragon
description: A woman in a black futuristic suit with glowing white patterns stands centered with arms outstretched before an ornate metallic gate. Behind her, a massive red and teal dragon with a human-like female face coils through a vibrant cosmic sky above a fantastical purple castle set in a mountainous landscape.
prompt: A woman in a sleek black futuristic bodysuit with glowing white circuit patterns stands centered with arms raised and palms open in front of an ornate metallic gate decorated with alchemical symbols. Behind the gate, a winding river valley leads to a grand purple and gold fantasy castle nestled in mountains under a swirling cosmic nebula sky filled with stars, glowing orbs containing miniature scenes, and a large serpentine red and teal dragon with a serene female human face. Vibrant purple, green, orange, and pink nebulae fill the sky with floating geometric symbols.
